mapper.select: SELECT ledger_sequence,ledger_hash FROM privacy_ledger_checkpoint WHERE owner_id=#{owner}
mapper.update: UPDATE privacy_ledger_checkpoint SET ledger_sequence=#{sequence},ledger_hash=#{hash},updated_at=#{now} WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND ledger_sequence=#{expectedSequence} AND ledger_hash=#{expectedHash}
mapper.select: SELECT object_kind,object_id,state,revision,latest_event_id,ledger_sequence,previous_status,trashed_at,updated_at FROM privacy_object_state WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND object_kind=#{kind} AND object_id=#{id}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preparation_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_card WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_board WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_attachment WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_session WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM interview_event WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_recollection WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_feedback WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM preparation_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_action WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM question_collection WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_scope_authorization WHERE owner_id=#{owner})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM privacy_object_state WHERE owner_id=#{owner})
